finding.summary: 论文要求检查“已违反 或 将违反”TTFT/TTLT；代码仅做 TTFT 前瞻（now+service_time>deadline），且仅对 drop==0 且未分配内存的请求生效，无 TTLT 维度。（artifact 范围：仅 TTFT 前瞻，缺 TTLT 与显式“已违反”判定。）

paper.quote: The violation checker module validates that the chosen request has not already violated (or will not violate) its QoS targets in the current iteration

analysis.tier_note: the reading and the probes disagree
analysis.reasoning: The shown scheduler code checks only TTFT via now + service_time_required > arrival_time + ttft_deadline, and only when drop == 0 and mem_allocated == False. No TTLT deadline or explicit already-violated check appears. The sequence fields include ttft_deadline but no TTLT field. This matches the finding that the artifact implements only TTFT lookahead and lacks TTLT and explicit already-violated validation.
analysis.would_confirm: A unit test constructing a request with a TTLT deadline and checking whether the scheduler validates or drops it would settle whether TTLT is enforced.
